gate_1_continued_derivative.claim: forward mode from a continued state (R1's, after 6 steps) equals central differences in fy, cy and k1, in both dtypes, within the interior tolerance (C h^2, C read from float64 times ten, plus the objective's rounding)

prediction.unit: relative error over its tolerance, the largest of the three leaves, per dtype
prediction.why: seen locally (above): float64 0.1, float32 under 0.1 of its tolerance; a runner's CPU moves float32's rounding term only

gate_1_continued_derivative.metric: the relative error of the AD derivative against the central difference, over the tolerance

control.plant: the code at da8d1679 (the cache held in the state, its derivative dropped from a continued state)
control.environment_variable: CAMERA_OLD_CODE (probe/old_code.py runs the test against da8d1679's src when set)
control.resolution: a dropped share s of the structure's derivative is caught where s / (1 - s) exceeds the tolerance: about 2e-3 to 5e-3 relative (derived from the tolerances; stated with discriminating_range.py over a scaled derivative)

gate_1_continued_derivative.if_wrong: a pass on da8d1679 means the window reads something besides the structure (the ball), so the test cannot see the defect; a fail on head means the run-constant's tangent is not the make's
gate_1_continued_derivative.cannot_discriminate_if: the objective's derivative were not the structure's alone (the ball in the window): then a dropped structure part would be a share, not all

gate_2_served_and_remade.claim: the structure is read while its numbers hold and made again when any of its 49 numbers differs, on the run-constant route and on MADDENING's history scan

prediction.value: served: the frame equals the marker's 250 counts everywhere; remade: equal to the clean frame bit for bit for each of the 49 numbers
prediction.why: the remake is the same compiled maker on the same leaves as the build's

gate_2_served_and_remade.metric: the frame's counts against the marker and against the clean frame

control.plant: numbers-not-compared (the held structure read whatever its numbers) and cache-every-frame (rendered in every frame, nothing held read)

gate_2_served_and_remade.if_wrong: a remade frame not bit for bit equal to the clean one says the in-chunk make and the build's compile differently: then state the difference's size and judge on it
gate_2_served_and_remade.cannot_discriminate_if: the marker equalled the transmission (it does not: 0.25 against the tube's 0.9 and the lumen's 1)

gate_3_two_builds.if_wrong: a quiet plant means the trace form does not see the camera's chunk (the run-constant made outside it)
